item.title: GitHub's Fake Star Economy
item.description:
📝 7 billion events and 326 million stars from 2019 to 2024 - and identified approximately 6 million suspected fake stars distributed across 18,617 repositories by roughly 301,000 accounts. At least a dozen active websites sell GitHub stars directly, including SocialPlug. The infrastructure extends beyond stars.
🔗 Read more: https://awesomeagents.ai/news/github-fake-stars-investigation/

item.description:

item.title: NSA is using Anthropic's Mythos despite blacklist
IEA: Solar overtakes all energy sources in a major global first
item.description:
📝 Global electricity demand jumped around 3% in 2025 – more than twice as fast as overall energy demand. Solar leads global energy growth for the first time Solar was the single biggest contributor to global energy supply growth in 2025. Overall, coal demand growth slowed.
🔗 Read more: https://electrek.co/2026/04/19/iea-solar-overtakes-all-energy-sources-in-a-major-global-first/
